During the quarter ended March 31, 2026, 9,000 ESOPs were exercised by eligible employees and the exercise price was paid in March 2026. However, the corresponding equity shares were allotted in April 2026. Accordingly, for the purpose of computing the No. of outstanding ESOPs granted in column XC, these 9,000 options have been considered as outstanding as on March 31, 2026, as there was no impact on the Companys paid-up share capital until the allotment was completed in April 2026. Consequently, the impact of these shares will be reflected in the shareholding pattern as of June 30, 2026.

1. 1,16,83,930 Ordinary (Equity) Shares held by Rujuvalika Investments Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Steel Limited w.e.f May 8, 2015), do not carry any voting rights. 2. Tata AIA Life Insurance Company Limited is not considered as part of Promoter Group and holds 1,20,74,431 Ordinary (Equity) Shares representing 0.097% of the paid-up Ordinary (Equity) Share Capital. Accordingly, holding of Tata AIA Life Insurance Company Ltd. is included under Public Shareholding under the head Institutions-Insurance Companies. 3. During the quarter ended June 30, 2018, Sir Ratan Tata Trust, Promoter Group Company, sold its entire shareholding in Tata Steel Limited. During the quarter ended March 31, 2026, Sir Dorabji Tata Trust sold 60,365 equity shares on March 9, 2026. The relevant disclosure in this regard was duly made to the Stock Exchanges under the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015. 4.During the quarter ended June 30, 2026, Tata Chemicals Limited, Promoter Group Company,  sold its entire shareholding of 309,00,510 Ordinary (Equity) Shares of the Company. Accordingly, it has ceased to be part of the Promoter Group. 5. Tata Sons Private Limited (TSPL) holds 31.76% in Tata Steel Limited as on June 30, 2026 and Tata Steel Limited is an associate of TSPL. TSPL being a Core Investment Company registered with RBI, is exempted under the Significant Beneficial Ownership (SBO) Rules. The Company does not have any other Significant Beneficial Owner under SBO Rules to be reported in the shareholding pattern as on June 30, 2026. 6. The total number of Ordinary (Equity) Shares include 4,370 Ordinary (Equity) Shares of face value Re.1/- each on which first and final call money has been received and the partly paid-up equity shares have been fully converted to fully paid-up equity shares but, are pending final listing and trading approval under the ISIN INE081A01020 (ISIN for fully paid-up shares), and hence, continue to be listed under the ISIN IN9081A010
